_evidence.tier_A: 580.x from 580.95.05 is validated by the Isaac Lab 3.0 docs; 595.58.03 is the only validated 595 build (595.71.05 / 595.79 / 595.84 are reported bad).
_evidence.tier_B: Any other 595.x or 590.x is accepted only if the launch probe passes. 595.91.07 carried the 2026-11-07/08 GA training (~4009 s), the adversarial gate and the eval runs to completion; startup SIGSEGVs (libcarb.tasking, exit 139) hit roughly one launch in two and occur within the first minutes. That is a flaky launch, not a dead driver, so a 3-launch probe answers it better than a blanket ban.
_evidence.reject: Below 580.65.06 there is no evidence of a working run; terminate the pod (it holds no data at this point). Three consecutive probe failures on a host reject that host too.

tier_b.why: flaky launch; requires a passing 3-launch probe
